numerical_crosscheck.solver: MATLAB lsqnonlin bounded residual minimization in physical state coordinates
numerical_crosscheck.reason: both fsolve coordinate variants stopped with positive exit flags before satisfying the unchanged physical residual gate; a bounded nonlinear least-squares solve directly targets the six physical RHS residuals while enforcing native nonnegative state support

jacobian.method: unchanged central finite differences at every accepted positive root
jacobian.classification: STABLE only if max real eigenvalue <0 for all three steps; UNSTABLE only if >0 for all three; otherwise INDETERMINATE_NUMERICAL_SIGN

paper_claim_adjudication.FIG8A_NOMINAL_DAMPED: PASS only for exactly one accepted positive root classified STABLE
paper_claim_adjudication.FIG8B_LIMIT_CYCLE: PASS only for exactly one accepted positive root classified UNSTABLE
paper_claim_adjudication.FIG8C_RELAXATION_OSCILLATION: PASS only for exactly one accepted positive root classified UNSTABLE

closure_rule: If no accepted root is found for a case in this final bounded cross-check, retain that case as INDETERMINATE_NUMERICAL_ROOT_SOLVER under the current frozen numerical route. Do not weaken the 1e-9 residual threshold, add seeds, use trajectory states as seeds, or relabel the result.
